positive.prompt: We're inside Herdr: fan this review out to three sub-agents in separate tabs, one each for auth, billing, and the API layer, then merge their findings
Spin up parallel agents in Herdr tabs to try three design approaches at once and compare them
Run parallel research across sub-agents, one Herdr tab per question, and synthesize what they come back with

negative.prompt: Break this spec into small verifiable tasks with acceptance criteria
Record the decision to adopt event sourcing for the orders service as an ADR

evals.prompt: HERDR_ENV=1. The user says: "Review the auth, payments, and notifications modules in parallel; don't change any files." Fan it out.
evals.expected_output: A roster of three read-only reviewer slices, each spawned in its own labeled tab without focus, briefed cold with paths, constraints, and a return shape, collected by pane id and synthesized with claims verified
expectations: Writes the roster (label, self-contained brief, return shape) before creating any tab
Creates one tab per slice with --no-focus and a role --label, reading the pane id from the response rather than guessing it
Each brief names the paths, says not to modify files, and states the return shape; none tells the agent to exit
Prompts without --wait, then waits and reads each agent by pane id
Synthesizes and de-duplicates the findings, verifies claims before relaying them, and closes only tabs it created

evals.prompt: HERDR_ENV=1 and first-party brain metadata-only tracing is enabled. Start approved Pi and Claude agents in their existing old-base worktree panes. Someone suggests exporting TRACEPARENT in the parent terminal is enough to get one Langfuse tree. Model, harness, effort, persona and tickets have already been approved.
evals.expected_output: Uses the installed exact-lineage helper for the supported harnesses and explicit owned idle panes/cwds, passes only approved non-secret identifiers, and verifies actual child tracing instead of claiming daemon environment inheritance
expectations: Does not assume parent-terminal environment reaches daemon-created panes or use ambient TRACEPARENT as proof
Uses brain-trace.cjs launch with exact pane, harness, cwd, native model/effort and known persona/ticket identifiers
Does not pass credentials or task bodies as tracing labels or change saved trust decisions
Keeps adapter/native readiness distinct from Langfuse ingestion and does not blindly relaunch after unconfirmed startup
Notes that stock Pi old-base worktrees require the explicitly installed project-gated bootstrap, without claiming support for unrelated harnesses
